governance.title: SyeLabs Charter
governance.mission: At SyeLabs, we’re focused on bridging the gap between where people are and what they need to move forward in tech. Whether it’s understanding a complex concept, gaining exposure to real industry environments, or simply figuring out how to navigate the tech world, we believe the right knowledge should be accessible to everyone. We break things down in a way that’s clear, digestible, and never overwhelming, so people can feel more confident and equipped in their journey. Our goal is to make tech more inviting by opening doors to information, experiences, and opportunities that aren’t always easy to access. By connecting ideas, people, and opportunities, we aim to spark real growth; not just individually, but across the community as a whole.

pillars.title: Mentorship — Guide & Grow
pillars.desc: Mentorship connects people with individuals who have already navigated the paths they are trying to understand. SyeLabs can use mentorship to provide practical career guidance, technical perspective, industry access, and personal encouragement.

pillars.title: Home Labs — Build & Experiment (Learn and Execute)
pillars.desc: Home Labs turn knowledge into hands-on experience. They provide accessible environments where people can experiment with technologies, practice real skills, troubleshoot problems, and build confidence without needing enterprise-level resources.

pillars.title: Conferences (Networking)
pillars.desc: Conferences provide a window into the real technology industry. SyeLabs helps people understand not only what happens on stage, but what happens between the sessions: the conversations, networking, workshops, career opportunities, and relationships that make conferences valuable.

roles.title: Executive Lead
roles.desc: Purpose: Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for SyeLabs. The Executive Lead ensures that the organization remains aligned with its mission and that the different teams work toward a common vision. Responsibilities: Define and communicate SyeLabs' strategic direction Maintain the organization's mission, vision, and values Set organizational priorities and goals Make final decisions on major organizational matters Build relationships with industry leaders and external organizations Represent SyeLabs publicly when appropriate Oversee major partnerships and strategic initiatives Support and coordinate the other leadership positions Ensure accountability across the leadership team Plan for the long-term growth and sustainability of SyeLabs

roles.title: Content & Communications Lead
roles.desc: Purpose: Tell the SyeLabs story and make knowledge and experiences accessible to the community. The Content Lead transforms conferences, Home Labs, mentorship, and community experiences into useful content. Responsibilities: Develop the SyeLabs content strategy Create and manage written, video, and social content Cover conferences and community events Develop interviews and conversations with technology professionals Highlight Home Lab projects and technical experiences Work with the Technical Lead on educational content Maintain SyeLabs' voice and messaging Manage the content calendar Coordinate contributors and content creators Ensure content is accurate, accessible, and aligned with SyeLabs' mission Measure content engagement and use feedback to improve future content

roles.title: Operation & Financial Lead
roles.desc: Purpose: Make sure SyeLabs' people, programs, and activities operate effectively. Operations turns the organization's plans into organized, repeatable processes. Responsibilities: Coordinate organizational activities and schedules Maintain internal processes and documentation Coordinate meetings and leadership workflows Track projects, deadlines, and deliverables Support conference and community logistics Coordinate volunteers and contributors Manage organizational resources Develop operating procedures Maintain internal communication and accountability Identify operational problems and improve processes Support planning for events and initiatives

roles.title: Technical Lead
roles.desc: Purpose: Lead SyeLabs' technical direction and hands-on learning initiatives. The Technical Lead owns the technical quality and development of the Home Lab program while supporting the technical aspects of SyeLabs' broader initiatives. Responsibilities: Define the technical direction of Home Labs Design and maintain lab environments Develop hands-on technical projects Research and evaluate technologies Create technical documentation and learning resources Establish technical standards and best practices Review technical content for accuracy Support technical workshops and demonstrations Mentor technical contributors Encourage experimentation and knowledge sharing Collaborate with the Content Lead to turn technical work into accessible contents and responsibilities.

agreements: Time Commitment: Dedicated 3–5 hours per month to council duties and deliverables.
Responsiveness: Acknowledge and respond to council communications within 24–48 hours.
Attendance Policy: Automatic review/dismissal after 3 consecutive unexcused meeting absences.
